import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    str_val = next(it).strip()
    b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(N)]
    res = sum(b)
    cnt = [0] * 26
    move = 0
    for i in range(N // 2):
        if str_val[i] == str_val[N - i - 1]:
            cnt[ord(str_val[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
            move += 1
            res -= min(b[i], b[N - i - 1])
    for i in range(26):
        if cnt[i] > move // 2:
            left = cnt[i] * 2 - move
            pos = []
            for j in range(N // 2):
                if str_val[j] != str_val[N - j - 1]:
                    if (ord(str_val[N - j - 1]) - ord('a') == i) or (ord(str_val[j]) - ord('a') == i):
                        # do nothing
                        pass
                    else:
                        pos.append(min(b[N - j - 1], b[j]))
            pos.sort()
            for j in range(left):
                res -= pos[j]
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
